{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patient_id duplicates: {len(duplicates)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check arm distribution
treatment_count = df['arm'].eq('treatment').sum()
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {treatment_count}")

# Check responded is binary
print(f"Unique values in 'responded': {df['responded'].unique()}")

# Display first few rows of the data
df.head()"}
